svg.title: A passage missing from the record is not a clean record
svg.desc: Top: a reader that trusts the record has only the record in front of it, six passages with nothing to flag, and thinks it fine. Bottom: the same record over the source capture it came from, seven passages. probity-verify pairs each source passage with its passage in the record, finds the fifth has none, and returns contradicted, reason selected_span_missing_from_record.
